title: Yoisaki Kanade — The Dream I Saw Will One Day〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: The Dream I Saw Will One Day（4★）

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I've been walking for a while now, but it's just an endless field of flowers...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's like the first time I came to SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's beautiful, but so lonely and quiet...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (As if I'm the only one left on this planet...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (No, now's not the time for that...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I need to find a way back soon. I need to visit mom's grave and work on our new song.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I'm running out of ideas for how to get back...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Just white flowers as far as the eye can see... Huh?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Oh! Did you buy these for me?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Thank you. This makes me so happy.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Hm? You're listening to daddy's music box again?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. I really like looking at flowers while listening to the music box that your father made.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: That way, even when I'm at the hospital, it feels like you and your father are right here with me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Was it carnations that we put in mom's casket during her funeral...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I barely remember any of it since I was so little...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I recall that there wasn't a cloud in the sky as a line of smoke rose into the air...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That was when I knew mom was going to heaven...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Mom always looked so happy when she was listening to her music box.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She'd smile sometimes to make sure I didn't get too worried about her.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But whenever she listened to that song on the music box, she seemed genuinely happy.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But it will be able to. Someday, I'll compose a song that can save someone.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Just like dad was able to do with mom, I will find a way...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(A light in the sky...?
But it looks too big for a star...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(They're multiplying...!
One by one, all over the place...!)

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: It's something your father made when we went on a trip together for the very first time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Yes. He said that what we saw was so beautiful, he wanted me to be able to remember it whenever I liked.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line:
This is a picture of what we saw.
Isn't it wonderful?

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
Wow...! It's so pretty!
All those twinkling stars!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: These are actually all lanterns. Everybody writes down their wishes and uses these to send them into the heavens.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Your father and I even wrote down our wishes and sent them up on some lanterns as well.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
Your wishes went up and up and up?
That sounds so cool! I wanna try too!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: We can all go send our wishes on these lanterns together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Right, this is what mom saw... This scene...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (So many lanterns floating up into the sky...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I didn't expect to find you here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If you're here, Miku, that means this is SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: In SEKAI, fragments of feelings that are yet to manifest as a SEKAI of their own can cement themselves and take on a form of their own...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That is why you were able to access this place as you did...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Fragments of feelings...
So that means this is...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I hope they can keep going up and up.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: All the way up into the heavens...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, it's already this late...
I need to visit mom's grave...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I have to take mom's music box...
Oh, and go there first too...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
He's asleep again today.
I haven't had any luck lately.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Dad...
I'm going to go see mom, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I've made sure to bring her music box and her favorite flowers to her grave.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I may not be able to now...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But someday, I will compose a song that can save someone. I'll compose a song that can save dad...)
